post.summary: Perform a blueprint transition on a ticket
post.description: Execute a blueprint transition on the specified ticket. Supply form-action payloads for approval, resolution, attachment, reply, comment, sharing, and field-update actions as required by the transition configuration. Only the action categories required by the transition need to be included.

parameters.name: ticket_id
parameters.description: Unique numeric identifier of the ticket.

parameters.name: transition_id
parameters.description: Unique numeric identifier of the blueprint transition to be performed.

requestBody.description: Form-action payloads for the transition. Provide only the action categories required by the transition configuration. Can be empty for transitions with no configured actions.

200.description: Blueprint transition performed successfully on the ticket.

fieldUpdateActionObject.description: Payload for the FIELD_UPDATE action of a blueprint transition. Keys are ticket field API names (for example priority, status, classification, or custom field API names) and values are the new values to be applied. Values can be string, number, boolean, array, or null depending on the field type.

performTransitionRequest.description: Request payload for performing a blueprint transition. Each property corresponds to a transition form-action category and is required only when the blueprint configuration mandates that action for the transition. The body can be empty for transitions with no configured actions.

performTransitionResponseObject.description: Response returned after a blueprint transition is performed. Reports any department change resulting from the transition.

departmentChanged.description: Indicates whether the ticket department changed as a result of performing the transition.

newDepartmentId.description: Identifier of the new department if the transition moved the ticket to a different department.
